g.data-redundancy-note: n+1. The C40G ships as two power variants and this group holds the bays for both: the AC chassis carries four front PSUs at n+1, the DC chassis two rear PEMs at 1+1 (HIG: wire the second PEM to a secondary supply for redundant power applications). Which bays are populated is a property of the configuration, not of the group
